scope: Centralized synthetic integer-credit simulations, all simple cycles in both signed directions. Cycle hops are a structural count, not network messages. No crash, privacy, consent, atomic distributed settlement, or new-link arrivals modeled here.
objective: sum(abs(canonical pair balance)); gross bilateral debt, not net node debt

ratchet.interpretation: Triangle scheduling demonstrates alternating shared capacity. An ordinary outer four-cycle also clears all 12 in the old model; this fixture does not establish an unrestricted optimum improvement.

rerouting.interpretation: Credit on the initially zero AC link replaces two debts with one; gross debt falls 6 to 3 while all net positions are unchanged.
